Add a step to duck-e-build (after docker-build succeeds) that clones jedarden/declarative-config, updates the image tag in k8s/ardenone-cluster/ducke/ducke-deployment.yml to the just-built version, commits (user.email github@jedarden.com, user.name jedarden), and pushes to origin — mirroring the existing pattern already used by telegram-claude-bridge-build and news-trader-build in the same WorkflowTemplates directory. This is a declarative-config manifest/workflow change only; no live kubectl mutation.
issue.title: Add auto-deploy step to duck-e-build so image bumps reach ardenone-cluster

issue.description: k8s/ardenone-cluster/ducke/ducke-deployment.yml (jedarden/declarative-config) defines no livenessProbe/readinessProbe on the duck-e container. app/main.py already exposes GET /status (health check + version) for this purpose per README's API endpoint table. Add both probes pointing at /status so k8s can detect a hung/crashed process and so the RollingUpdate (maxSurge:1, maxUnavailable:0) actually waits for the new pod to be ready before considering rollout progressed. Manifest-only change in declarative-config; ship via commit+push, ArgoCD sync.
issue.title: Add liveness/readiness probes to ducke-deployment.yml

[migrated comment from bf-4m6, 2026-07-30T03:18:19.089128979Z, author cli]
Gap: workspace policy is that GitHub Actions are disabled across all repos and CI/CD runs on Argo Workflows (this repo's real pipeline is the duck-e-build WorkflowTemplate in iad-ci, publishing ronaldraygun/duck-e). Yet two live workflows are committed:

- .github/workflows/docker-release.yml — triggers on push to main, builds and pushes to ghcr.io (REGISTRY: ghcr.io, IMAGE_NAME: github.repository). Duplicates/conflicts with the Argo build and is the origin of the stale 'ghcr.io/jedarden/duck-e' references in README.md and CLAUDE.md.
- .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml — gitleaks on push/PR to main.

Note (workspace learning gh_actions_repo_level_drift): deleting the workflow files is NOT sufficient to stop GH Actions — Actions must be disabled at the REPO level in Forgejo/GitHub settings. Deleting yml files alone leaves the capability enabled.

Acceptance criteria:
- GitHub Actions disabled at the repo level (Forgejo source of truth + GitHub mirror), not just via file deletion.
- .github/workflows/docker-release.yml and secret-scan.yml removed (or kept only if a documented ghcr.io mirror is genuinely desired, coordinated with bf-3ip).
- No remaining push-to-ghcr path, so README/CLAUDE.md registry facts can be made consistent (ronaldraygun/duck-e via duck-e-build).
